title: BeeSmart Hive Finding
description: Shows the swarm intelligence of honeybees during their hive-finding process: a small population of scout bees explores the surroundings, advertises candidate hive sites through waggle dances of varying enthusiasm, and the swarm converges on the best available site once a quorum of bees is reached at that site — with no central coordinator.
notes: This is the first model in a larger 'BeeSmart' computational-modeling curricular unit (per the model's own Info tab); later models in that unit (a HubNet participatory-simulation variant, 'Multiple Check World', 'Debate World') are referenced as 'coming soon' on the source site and are not included here. Unlike the rest of this collection (redistributed from OpenEvo/TeachingBase under CC BY-SA), this model is sourced directly from the official NetLogo Models Library and keeps its own original CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 license — see the license block below and this model's README.md before reusing it commercially.
